release_summary: Round 3. (1) Measured, trustworthy findings: a 120-item labelled evaluation (40 development, 40 held-out round 1, 40 fresh held-out round 2; 33 clean controls) run by the production engine; round 1 measured 96.2% precision / 86.2% recall, its five failures were fixed in the engine, and the fresh round 2 measured 93.5% / 93.5%, shown in Trust & Audit → Reliability and enforced in CI; tone & messaging checks citing the approved brand voice guide. (2) Every format, page by page: multi-page PDFs and PowerPoint decks with page navigation, thumbnails and zoom; measured accessibility findings (text contrast against WCAG 4.5:1 / 3:1, small text, missing or unhelpful alt text); documents revised by uploading the corrected file. (3) From repeated mistakes to clearer guidelines: insights by rule, channel, campaign and team; possibly unclear rules flagged from reviewer overrides and needs-review volume; clarified rules replayed on history and applied only by a different manager with an audit record. Landing page unchanged.

owner_next_step: Existing owners sign in normally. Judges choose Explore demo; the Round 3 features open from More to explore or the cards on Home.
limits: Functional release verification; no penetration test, large-scale load certification or user study is claimed. The evaluation set is synthetic and team-labelled; it measures the rule engine, not live AI suggestions.
judge_access: Explore demo; no credentials. Opens on the marked Inkloom AI ad. Four roles, isolated two-hour workspace, sample files and bounded live AI.
follow_up_fixes: A strict live check of every documented claim found three failures, now fixed: a judgement call accepted on version 1 is carried to the corrected version when the same rule raises the same question with unchanged surrounding wording (labelled carried over), so the walkthrough approves; logo text is exempt from contrast as WCAG allows; the sample footer is darker so the corrected ad passes contrast under live OCR. Also: tone and accessibility rules can be created in the rule editor; Home counts tone and accessibility issues. Live AI behaviour: a suggestion that cannot quote its source is hidden (and counted) without marking the check incomplete, and AI suggestions are not shown on values the rule engine verified against the same approved record.
additions: Brand colour palette check (judgement call with swatches); check-before-publish API with hashed, revocable, rate-limited workspace keys and an Integrations test console; daily GitHub Actions live claim check; accessibility audit of 24 workspace screens (23 issues fixed, 0 remaining); RESPONSIBLE_DESIGN.md, TESTING.md, ROADMAP.md, CHANGELOG.md, API.md.

landing_without_webgl: If a browser cannot create a WebGL context, the landing shows a still image of the same 3D scene (desktop and mobile versions, loaded only in that case) in place of the placeholder disc, and a notice explains how to turn on graphics acceleration to see the interactive original. Added by the hosting layer (public/brand-crew/host-still.js); the approved landing source is unchanged (sha256 prefix 3f8540e6ec92). Verified on the staged and production deployments with WebGL disabled (still and notice shown, desktop and mobile) and enabled (live 3D, no notice).
ai_retry: Found by the final live check: a busy AI provider (HTTP 500-504) is now retried twice, after 1 s and 3 s, within the 55-second limit, and the message says the service is temporarily busy instead of pointing at configuration. 2 tests added (87 total).
ai_fallback: Free backup model: if gemini-3.5-flash-lite is still busy after its retries (HTTP 500-504) or out of free daily quota (HTTP 429), gemini-3.1-flash-lite answers. Configuration errors never switch models, an unavailable backup never hides the real problem, and every result is labelled with the model that produced it. No paid tier is used. 7 tests added (94 total).
